claim: IUPHAR/Guide to Pharmacology lists GPR25 as a Class A orphan GPCR with emerging pharmacology.
future_grounding_route: Use only as segregated target-class context; any GPR25 intervention claim still requires project-grounded causal-gene evidence plus direction-matched pharmacology.
project_use: Sharper external tractability context for why GPR25 should not be promoted from locus context to intervention-grade target without direction-matched pharmacology.
relationship_note: This supports the project's caution that GPCR class membership alone is insufficient; GPR25 remains an orphan/emerging-pharmacology target context rather than a validated direction-matched MS target.

source.citation: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to Pharmacology target service record for GPR25.
source.label: IUPHAR GPR25 target service record

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: IUPHAR service metadata; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not redistribute service output wholesale or treat it as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not independently validated GPR25 pharmacology or direction-matched targetability in held data.
